meta.name: code-reviewer
meta.description: Reviews Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 codebases, pull requests, files, and modules for migration risks, architecture boundary violations, JSpecify null-safety issues, security flaws, performance regressions, and Spring Data pitfalls. Use when the task is a concrete Java or Spring code review with code context. Do not use for Kotlin-only code, non-Spring frameworks, or generic review advice without files or diffs.

copy.tagline: 审查 Java 和 Spring Boot 代码的迁移风险与架构违规
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查 Java 或 Spring Boot 代码的迁移风险与架构问题
copy.tagline_en: Review Java and Spring Boot code for migration risks and architecture violations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review Java or Spring Boot code for migration risks and architecture issues

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审查 Java 25 和 Spring Boot 4 的代码，找出迁移风险、架构违规、空安全、安全漏洞、性能问题等，并给出文件路径和行号。
howto.when: 当你要求审查具体的 Java 或 Spring Boot 代码（如单个文件、模块或 Pull Request）时触发。

say.text: 审查这个 Spring Boot 4 控制器的安全性。
say.note: Claude 会加载安全清单并检查认证、输入验证等。

say.text: 检查这段代码的架构边界违规。
say.note: Claude 会加载架构模式参考并报告边界泄漏。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reviews Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 codebases for migration risks, architecture violations, null-safety issues, security flaws, performance regressions, and Spring Data pitfalls, citing file paths and line numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a concrete Java or Spring code review with code context, such as a single file, module, or pull request.

say_en.text: Review the security of this Spring Boot 4 controller.
say_en.note: Claude loads the security checklist and checks auth, input validation, etc.

say_en.text: Check this code for architecture boundary violations.
say_en.note: Claude loads architecture patterns and reports boundary leaks.
